pages.lesson:
LESSON: INTERDEPENDENCE OF PEOPLE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Population
Topic 2.1: Interdependence of people

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Interdependence of people. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do people in the county depend on each other?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county
2. explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county
3. use chart to illustrate the benefits of interdependence people

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county
   In simple words: practise until you can identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. use chart to illustrate the benefits of interdependence people
   In simple words: practise until you can use chart to illustrate the benefits of interdependence people. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Interdependence of people using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Interdependence of people in the examples.
2. Explain Interdependence of people to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Interdependence of people.
4. Show that you can: identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Interdependence of people using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Interdependence of people important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Draw a chart on benefits of interdependence among the people,
2. Role-play interdependence of people in the community,
3. Citizenship: Learners explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county.
4. Social cohesion: Learners identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county.
5. Social cohesion: Learners respect others’ views/feelings as they work to create a chart on benefits of interdependence among people. Links to other Learning Areas:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do people in the county depend on each other?
2. Why should we support each other in the county?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county
2. explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county
3. use chart to illustrate the benefits of interdependence people

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
